_comment: Content for the data-driven regions of index.html (the package list and the lesson gallery). Edit here, then run `melos run web:landing` to regenerate index.html. `melos run web:landing:check` (and CI) fail if index.html drifts from this file or from the workspace (a published package or a lesson with no entry here).

packages.line: Describe a video, render an MP4. This is the one that does the magic.
fluvie render <key> --out file.mp4. Headless, scriptable, no editor in sight.
Catches timing and layering mistakes before they catch you.
Check a Video build() snippet before you render it: the analyzer plus the lint rules, run in-process, never executed.
Turn a plain sentence into a VideoSpec, or drop AI-generated images, video, and audio straight into a scene.
One set of contracts for every AI provider and medium: text, image, video, speech, sound, and music.
Render API, MCP server, and a docs helper in one binary. Host the full AI stack yourself.
Render to MP4 on the phone itself, no FFmpeg and nothing leaves the device.
Render to MP4 in the browser with ffmpeg.wasm, opt-in, nothing leaves the page.
